data.rationale: The proposal follows the right overall procedure and parameters, but it picks the "top recipe" instead of the first recipe with 4 or more stars. It also leaves out the "don't click a time slot or Reserve" constraint, and it adds a neighbourhood note and a "select all" step that the true workflow doesn't have, so an automation built from it could choose the wrong recipe or click something it shouldn't.
